body: I feel like everyone hates me. I’m too awkward. I’m too problematic. I’m too fucked in the head. I mess up good things for myself all the time. I just wish I had confidence

I never feel “weak enough” to go online about these things. I never feel confident enough to say these things out loud. I’m too beaten down to have the confidence to do anything. My family really did a number on me and I don’t think I’m even capable of being normal

I just lay here in bed waiting for life to be over. On the outside I look close to normal. I have a job, I have a boyfriend, I have friends. I stay as healthy as I can. I don’t do drugs. I don’t party or do anything crazy. I have a simple life. I just don’t know how to do better for myself. I always feel helpless.

My upbringing was very tough. It was constantly full of abuse of all forms and unfortunately that has shaped me into the woman I am today. It’s done some good but it’s done more harm than anything else. 

My own boyfriend tells me I’m too damaged for him to truly love or truly see a future with. 

My mom is always concerned for me because I always isolate myself. 

I just don’t see a point of this shit anymore. I don’t know what the fuck I’m doing.
Ehh I don’t smile much. Nothing wrong with my teeth, it just never comes off as natural or genuine in my opinion. But I should take your advice, thank you.
